summary: Discovered 22 major dairy processing units, craft breweries, and beverage bottling plants in Maharashtra actively expanding capacity or upgrading MPCB effluent compliance. Target buyers: Plant Head / Engineering Chief.

profile.offer: Turnkey Industrial Reverse Osmosis (RO) Plants (20 to 100 KLD), Ultrafiltration & Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) Systems
profile.target_market: Commercial dairies, fruit pulp & juice processors, beverage bottlers, and breweries across Maharashtra industrial clusters
profile.geography: Maharashtra, India (Pune, Kolhapur, Sangli, Nashik, Baramati)
profile.icp_hypothesis: Processing units handling >50,000 L/day raw liquids with high TDS borehole feed water facing MPCB water recycling norms or boiler scale issues
differentiators: High-recovery energy saving membranes (up to 85% recovery)
Turnkey install with guaranteed TDS <30 ppm
